description: Latest river flow in cubic metres per second (cumecs) at one gauge, or at the nearest flow gauges to a point. The number kayakers, canoeists and anglers ask for. Source: Environment Agency real-time flood-monitoring API. Pass station_id for one gauge, or lat and lon to search nearby; only some gauges measure flow, and readings older than 6 hours are flagged stale. (cost: 1 credit)

dist_km.description: number, optional, search radius in km, 0.5-50, default 15

lat.description: number, optional, latitude (required if no station_id)

limit.description: integer, optional, gauges returned when searching, 1-5, default 3

lon.description: number, optional, longitude (required if no station_id)

station_id.description: string, optional, Environment Agency station reference, e.g. 1490TH; use this or lat and lon

name: river_flow_now
